scores.rationale: The candidate implements the wrong protocol message names and types (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame` with a `sessions` field) instead of what the issue explicitly specifies (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationCursor` with a `conversations` field). Furthermore, its validator allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200`, directly violating the acceptance criterion that `limit` must be an integer 1–200 (and rejecting `0` and `201`). It also modifies existing lines in `src/types/messages.ts` despite the requirement that `git diff` of that file touch no existing line, logs raw store error messages (`error.message`) which can leak database credentials, and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the repository. Finally, it omits major ticket requirements including updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, startup warnings when `history` is enabled without `resume`, and several required test cases (e.g., streaming concurrency, reconnecting with a listed session ID, and additive protocol fixture checks).
